But the narrative adds claims that the packet does not support, and the next steps are internally inconsistent with the narrative, so an investigator would have to redo some work.","problems":["Claims the 99215 share is 'elevated in every complexity stratum'; the card shows 4-condition stratum at 0.167 vs 0.117 (elevated) but the comparison is of provider share to all-provider share, not expected; loosely supported, and the 0-condition stratum is 0.07 vs 0.024, fine, but 'consistent with upcoding' is stated more strongly than z=1.03 warrants.","Text says 'some visit times repeat' and 'problems flag appears on a large share of notes' (39%); repeated visit times are not on the card, so ungrounded.","Names flagged notes C0111264, C0111314, C0111396, C0111404, C0111920 that do not appear in the evidence card, so the investigator cannot verify why they are flagged.","Describes C0111836 as 'depression with URI' which matches dx F32.9;J06.9, but the card lists it as 1 condition and the 'no time recorded' detail is fine; however it is called a supported 99215 yet used to suggest cloned content with no evidence.","Cites C0111481 and C0111309 in the narrative but they are not in cited_claim_ids, and the final next steps list only C0111338, C0111239, C0111252, ignoring the flagged notes and the audit trail request mentioned in the narrative.","Example C0111252 (82-year-old with asthma) and C0111239 have no documentation in the card, so citing them as examples adds little; the next step is generic.","The summary says the records 'neither confirm nor clear', yet also states the pattern 'is consistent with upcoding', which is mixed messaging."]}
